value.rationale: A complete optimal sixth-moment and equality-phase classification for the first nontrivial four-tap unimodular Fourier aperture gives a natural small-scale flatness benchmark; its continuous optimum is strictly below all binary phases and unobtainable from any finite root-of-unity alphabet. A precise fourth/sixth tradeoff demonstrates that the value cannot be deduced by recycling the published L4 minimum. No downstream engineering impact is presumed.
